title.narrative: The Endangered Wildlife Trust- Empowering Good Governance through Information
The Endangered Wildlife Trust- Empowering Good Governance through Information

description.narrative: The project aims to promote Good governance by empowering government official and citizens with relevant, current and reliable information relating to the country environmental legal and governance framework in relation to natural resource and the law. The EWT ,EGGI project adddress two core challenges in South Africa relating to natural resources.These challenges are - inadequate access and comphrension by the public in respect of the legal and governnance framework in South Africa as it relates to wildlife, secondly the lack of accountability and good governnace in South Africa governmental departments responsible for the environment.
